pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Heterogeneous dark brown polygonal regions with irregular, serrated edges. Individual patches exhibit moderate edge-softness in pixel gradients. Spatial area is largest on the central flank, transitioning to smaller, more densely packed geometries toward the posterior.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous light-colored topological graph with tri-radial and tetra-radial junction nodes. Pixel thickness of corridors is variable, demonstrating expansion in the mid-flank zone and constriction toward the dorsal and posterior regions.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette along the cervical and dorsal ridge. The pixel transition between the mane and background is moderately diffuse.
